## Read in data boundaries

```{r 1. Project Setup, message = FALSE}
## Read in data

# California boundary
cal_gpkg <- "Data/Raw/california.gpkg"
cal_boundary <- read_sf(cal_gpkg)
print(cal_boundary)

plot(cal_boundary)

# Counties boundaries
# https://data.ca.gov/@california-department-of-technology/california-county-boundaries-and-identifiers

counties_boundary <- read_sf("Data/Raw/Raw_large/California_County_Boundaries_and_Identifiers_Blue_Version_view_-4451679308524472862.gpkg")


# Trinity county
trinity_county <- counties_boundary %>%
  select(CDTFA_COUNTY,SHAPE) %>%
  filter (CDTFA_COUNTY == "Trinity County")

plot(trinity_county)
```
